Under the terms of the issuance, the 5.75% senior notes are due in 2031 and will rank equally alongside AltaGas's existing senior unsecured debt. Parent company AltaGas Ltd. is providing a full and unconditional guarantee for the notes.
The offering is slated to close on October 1, 2026.

AltaGas intends to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including paying down balances under its credit facility and potentially redeeming or repurchasing a portion of its outstanding medium-term notes.
